description: Save the shopper's default size and/or fit on their allover.art account, so later chats can skip asking. Call it only when the human states a size or fit or asks you to remember one; read it back with get_user_prefs. Pass only what they stated: an omitted field keeps its saved value, an empty string clears it. size is XS, S, M, L, XL or 2XL–5XL (case-insensitive); fit is basic or oversized. The saved size fills in add_to_cart when size is omitted, and the fit maps to search_products style (basic → tee, oversized → oversized). Any other size or fit returns an error and saves nothing. ai_opt_in (true or false) saves the AI tools switch — pass it only when they say so. It turns AI tools on or off for a designer or an admin; a shopper's AI tools stay on whatever it says. While the account does not keep this choice yet it returns an error and saves nothing.

ai_opt_in.description: The AI tools switch: true — on, false — off (for designers and admins; a shopper keeps AI tools either way). Omit to keep the saved choice.

fit.description: Fit preference: basic or oversized; empty string clears it.

size.description: Default size: XS, S, M, L, XL, 2XL…5XL; empty string clears it.
